title: Scribbling Squidlet
statement: This thumb-sized squid drifts through amber, lamplit water, looping trails of softly glowing ink into curly half-sentences that dissolve before they're finished. Between thoughts it arranges the pebbles among its kelp stacks into tidy spirals, then flutters a tentacle at whichever visitor lingers longest, as if to ask what they're wondering about.
